description: The requester asks the guest agent to start the guest requester (socialweb-r2.service, run request --guest-requester as the r2 user) of a contract with spec.association.fromGuest; sent as the payload of a market.event. Requester-originated only. It carries no secret.

name.description: The guest requester's invocation name, a DNS label.

agent.description: The guest requester asks for an atirc agent on its own guest and starts it once held.

hold.description: The guest requester keeps its own contract held.
